card.title: Anything but That Question
card.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll return your spare key after dinner. Have you booked somewhere?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I never gave you a spare key. Where did you get it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's get a table before everywhere fills up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked. Did my sister give you that key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For two or three? We can't leave your sister without dinner.

mechanism: A keeps shifting from the unexplained key's origin to dinner arrangements, even when B names a possible source.
confusable: Unlike steering suspicion toward a rival cause, A refuses to discuss the incriminating detail at all.
comparison: A changes a sister clue into guest numbers, whereas the photo scene changes a bracelet clue into a gift.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
